verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime publishes its own Postman Collection for exploring the API, which is a machine-readable request collection and a plausible 'equivalent' to a spec. However, probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, and no downloadable OpenAPI document is documented; the 'summary:' fields on reference pages only hint at an underlying spec. Missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file, an explicit download link or version info for the Postman Collection, independent corroboration that the collection is complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: you can do your testing as in command line or using our Postman Collection to speed up your initial exploration of our APIs.
